input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: polish: blog/updates renderer showed typed HTML entities and raw <sub>/<sup> as text

errors.what: A full site build aborted partway because it loaded docs/posts while I was editing a draft whose description was 167 characters (limit 160); dist was left partial and check.mjs reported 18,833 problems.
errors.fix: Shortened the description and rebuilt; the next build passed check.mjs. Lesson: don't edit docs/posts while a build is running.

errors.what: First version restored entities before sub/sup, so a typed <sub> would have become a real tag.
errors.fix: Swapped the order and added a test before committing.

doc_friction.issue: Says 'The next run starts from that list' (the docs/reports note) but not where the notes are; they are docs/reports/polish-*.md, and `ls -t` there is useless in a fresh clone (every mtime is the same), so sort by name. Nine polish runs landed today, so the newest 'Still weakest' lists overlap and carry items another open PR (#15905) already took.

notes: Picked research-entities report item 2. PR #15905 already covers the blog byline row and the custom-development menu entities (354 of the site's 418 double-escaped entities), so those were left alone. Verification: node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs' 1,637 pass / 0 fail on the first renderer change, rerun after the sub/sup change: 1,636 pass, 1 fail ('an identical build produces an identical cache name', two concurrent builds hashed differently because I edited this run record, which the build reads, mid-run); that test alone rerun clean: pass; platform/devlog/devlog.test.mjs 17/17; check.mjs on the full rebuild: publishable, 9,712 pages, no dead links. Old vs new renderer over 4,534 posts: sub/sup tags shown as text 68 -> 0, typed entities 4 -> 0; 9 posts' rendering changed, all checked by diff.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior front-end dev: find renderer fault, safe allowlist, tests, diff 4,534 posts, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
